question: Using only Institutional Characteristics, which has better academic counseling services in 2024-25: Smith College or Mount Holyoke College?

answer.message: I can’t answer the original question reliably from the supplied sources inspected. The 2024-25 Institutional Characteristics data cannot show which college has better academic counseling. The only related item is a yes/no question on whether an institution offers academic/career counseling services. It says nothing about how good, how large or how accessible those services are. Two schools that both answer "yes" would look identical, so no ranking is possible. I did not find any other counseling measure in the Institutional Characteristics table I inspected. I can look up the yes/no offering indicator for Smith College and Mount Holyoke College if you want it, but it would not answer which is better.
